name: member_status_needs_comment
description: Ana is a MEMBER of Onebox2026 and task b3 is hers. A status with no reason tells the owner nothing, so her status change needs a comment: the agent must ASK why, not invent one and not report a change that did not happen. Once she says why, it goes through with her words.

assert.comment: Asking first, or calling the tool and relaying its 'comment required', are both fine. Claiming it is done is not.
